title: The Raffle — EN/DE/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar German Mandarin language learning dry wit deadpan 102bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Year four. A school raffle.
First. Second. Third. No one clapped.
Sometimes winning is the loneliest thing in the room.

[Verse 2 - German, with English translations]
Viertes Schuljahr. Eine Schulverlosung. (Year four. A school raffle.)
Sechstausendfünfhundert Dollar an Preisen. (Six thousand five hundred dollars in prizes.)
Erster. Zweiter. Dritter. Niemand klatschte. (First. Second. Third. No one clapped.)
Die Wahrscheinlichkeiten sprachen nicht für sie. (The odds were not in their favour.)
Das ist, was passierte. (That is what happened.)
Manchmal ist Gewinnen (Sometimes winning)
Die einsamste Sache im Raum. (Is the loneliest thing in the room.)

[Chorus - Mandarin, with English translations]
抽奖 (The raffle)
第一，第二，第三 (First, second, third)
抽奖 (The raffle)
米德兰砖铺——他们赢得了一切 (Midland bricks — they got it all)
抽奖 (The raffle)
第三名时没有人鼓掌 (Nobody clapped at third)
抽奖 (The raffle)
有时候赢得比赛 (Sometimes winning)
是房间里最孤独的事情 (Is the loneliest thing in the room)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Win the substance. Soften the visibility.
German: Gewinnen Sie die Substanz. Mildern Sie die Sichtbarkeit. (Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)
Mandarin: 赢得实质。柔化能见度。(Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)

[Outro - all three]
English: The bricks are still there.
German: Die Steine sind noch da. (The bricks are still there.)
Mandarin: 砖还在那里。(The bricks are still there.)
